links.outcome: CAD sensitivity across four sites, lesion subgroups, and imaging modes
links.effect: Sensitivity 92.0% (WLI) and 96.5% (LCI). WLI-CAD EYE was lower for lesions <10 mm (88.9%) and anterior wall (79.4%); LCI-CAD EYE was ≥90% in all subgroups.
links.quote: WLI-CAD EYE showed relatively low sensitivity for lesions < 10 mm (88.9%) and those located on the anterior wall (79.4%), whereas LCI-CAD EYE achieved ≥ 90% sensitivity in all subgroups.

screen.reason: This prospective multicenter confirmatory clinical trial evaluated the diagnostic performance (sensitivity) of a real-time computer-aided detection (CADe) tool during live endoscopy, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
